note: From the first real flight data the project has been given. A third field in the Measured mass & CG box - Pad weight (with motor) - lets the app carry the adapter, retainer and closure weight the catalogue motor leaves out (182 g and 129 g on the two flights that prompted it), so the pad mass and the recovery weight are what you weighed. The thrust-curve picker now checks a file's impulse against the motor's certification - fourteen motors change file, and as with v0.111 a curve you had already downloaded is discarded, so re-pick the motor on a design you have open. And when the only curve for a motor is more than 5 percent from its certified impulse, the design notes now say so; 69 motors carry that line today.
